# Public English Lingua Libre pronunciations

`en-uk-above-all.wav` and `en-uk-air-pollution.wav` are unmodified Lingua Libre
recordings published on Wikimedia Commons under CC0 1.0, resampled to 16 kHz
mono for the eval harness. They are short public speech, not a dialect bakeoff.
The canonical deed is <https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>;
the complete legal code is bundled at
[`packaging/licenses/CC0-1.0.txt`](../../../../../packaging/licenses/CC0-1.0.txt).
Resampling is the only DCENT_Voice modification to these recordings.

- Speaker: [Brian-emurse](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:Lingua_Libre_pronunciation_by_Brian-emurse)
- Sources:
  - <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LL-Q1860_(eng)-Brian-emurse-above_all.wav>
  - <https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:LL-Q1860_(eng)-Brian-emurse-air_pollution.wav>
- SHA-256:
  - `en-uk-above-all.wav`: `bdd673e97c5bbc478121454c0cacbb5518ed8484254797166c4174373af40c4d`
  - `en-uk-air-pollution.wav`: `0f6ef569857f1e5313e7edd251a828cd65de0033e960d27d7ce266a24e41df6b`

A sentence-length accented-English public set was not available locally this
pass. These two clips are **not** claimed as Indian/Scottish/Australian coverage.
